description: The live signal cards: compiled, provenance-carrying observations (lead_lag, network, signature) with severity and the entities they name. Cards appear only while their type is armed; an answer with no cards costs nothing. Observations, not advice. Agent keys only. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code (e.g. DE); cards about entities in that country.

kind.description: One signal family: lead_lag | network | signature. Default all three.

name: signals
